name: Base-4 self numbers
description: Positive integers not of the form m plus the sum of the base-4 digits of m.

name: Numbers containing 1
description: Positive integers containing at least one decimal digit 1.

name: Numbers containing 9
description: Positive integers containing at least one decimal digit 9.

name: Numbers containing 0
description: Nonnegative integers containing a decimal digit 0, including 0.

name: Cumulative distinct prime factors
description: Partial sums of ω(m), the number of distinct prime divisors of m, starting at m = 1 with a(1) = 0.

name: Odd nonprimes
description: Odd positive integers that are not prime, including 1.

name: Ternary palindromes
description: Nonnegative integers whose base-3 expansion is palindromic, including 0.

name: Odd digits only
description: Positive integers whose decimal digits all belong to 1, 3, 5, 7, 9.

name: Even digits only
description: Nonnegative integers whose decimal digits all belong to 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, including 0.

name: Twin-prime centers
description: Arithmetic means of twin-prime pairs, in increasing order. Each jump uses the next center.

name: 3-almost primes
description: Positive integers with exactly three prime factors, counted with multiplicity.

name: 4-almost primes
description: Positive integers with exactly four prime factors, counted with multiplicity.

name: 5-almost primes
description: Positive integers with exactly five prime factors, counted with multiplicity.

name: Prime plus its index
description: a(n) = p(n) + n, where p(n) is the n-th prime and n starts at 1.

name: Odd power-of-two residues
description: Positive integers m for which the least nonnegative residue of 2^m modulo m is odd.

name: Digit-sum orbit from 3
description: Start at 3; each next term is the current term plus its decimal digit sum.

name: Digit-sum orbit from 9
description: Start at 9; each next term is the current term plus its decimal digit sum.

name: Not two nonzero squares
description: Positive integers not representable as x² + y² with positive integers x and y.

name: Hoax numbers
description: Composite integers whose decimal digit sum equals the sum of the decimal digit sums of their distinct prime factors.

name: Square plus seven times a square
description: Nonnegative integers representable as x² + 7y² with integers x and y, including 0.

name: Sums of two triangular numbers
description: Nonnegative integers representable as T(x) + T(y), where T(j) = j(j+1)/2 and x, y are nonnegative.

name: Not two triangular numbers
description: Nonnegative integers not representable as a sum of two triangular numbers.

name: Not two squares
description: Nonnegative integers not representable as a sum of two integer squares.

name: Square plus cube
description: Nonnegative integers representable as x² + y³ with nonnegative integers x and y, including 0.

name: Prime factors of factorials
description: Total number of prime factors of n!, counted with multiplicity, starting at n = 1 with a(1) = 0.

name: Beatty: √5
description: a(n) = floor(n√5), for n ≥ 1; computed with an exact integer square root.

name: Divisor sum at least 3n
description: Positive integers m satisfying σ(m) ≥ 3m.

name: Lesser cousin primes
description: Primes p for which p + 4 is prime. Jumps use consecutive primes of this subsequence.

name: Lesser sexy primes
description: Primes p for which p + 6 is prime. Jumps use consecutive primes of this subsequence.

name: Beatty: √7
description: a(n) = floor(n√7), for n ≥ 1; computed with an exact integer square root.
